articles.title: Festival Turns Nightmare in Damoh: Teen Killed on Way to Sister’s House, Villagers Allege Chilling
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: What was meant to be a day celebrating sibling bonds during Bhai Dooj turned into a horrific tragedy in Samanna village of Damoh district, Madhya Pradesh, where a 16-year-old boy was brutally murdered in broad daylight.

body.html:
What was meant to be a day celebrating sibling bonds during Bhai Dooj turned into a horrific tragedy in Samanna village of Damoh district, Madhya Pradesh, where a 16-year-old boy was brutally murdered in broad daylight.

The victim, Bharat Vishwakarma (16), was reportedly on his way to visit his sister when he was allegedly attacked from behind by Gudda Patel, a man who had recently been released from jail.

According to police, the incident took place around 1:30 pm when Patel allegedly struck the boy with a rod, knocking him to the ground, and then repeatedly attacked him with a hammer, killing him on the spot.

Eyewitnesses have made disturbing claims about what happened after the assault. Locals said the accused allegedly drank blood from the victim’s head and attempted to eat flesh before trying to flee into nearby fields.

Villagers rushed to the spot within minutes and reportedly saw the accused standing near the body and behaving in what they described as an “inhuman” manner.

Eyewitness Bhagwandas Patel said the accused lived nearby and had earlier served jail time for the murder of his wife. He alleged that Patel first knocked the boy down with a rod and then began drinking blood from his head. According to him, Patel later brought a hammer and appeared to try to eat flesh from the victim’s head before attempting to escape.

Villagers chased the accused and managed to surround and catch him before police arrived.

The victim’s family said there had been no dispute or argument between the boy and the accused. Vijay Vishwakarma, the boy’s brother, said Bharat had simply been heading to his sister’s house for the festival when he was attacked.

HR Pandey, Chief Superintendent of Police of Damoh, confirmed that the accused was apprehended by villagers after attempting to flee. He also stated that Patel had previously served a jail sentence for murdering his wife.

Police said there are claims that the accused may have developed a mental disorder, and a medical examination will be conducted to assess his mental condition.

An investigation is currently underway, and statements of witnesses are being recorded.

The brutal killing has left residents of Samanna village in shock, with many describing the incident as something they had never witnessed before.

articles.title: Caught on CCTV: Woman Brutally Smashes Puppies Against Wall in Tamil Nadu, FIR Registered
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case of alleged animal cruelty has emerged from Tamil Nadu, where a woman was caught on CCTV allegedly killing puppies and reportedly hanging others from a tree following a personal dispute with a family living opposite her house.

body.html:
A disturbing case of alleged animal cruelty has emerged from Tamil Nadu, where a woman was caught on CCTV allegedly killing puppies and reportedly hanging others from a tree following a personal dispute with a family living opposite her house.

The incident came to light after a video of the act, recorded on March 4, went viral on social media. The footage was shared on X by animal activist Vidit Sharma.

The CCTV video shows a rickshaw with a Tamil Nadu registration plate parked in the area while several puppies wander and bark nearby. Moments later, a woman walks into the frame from a nearby house. She is seen picking up a puppy from beneath the rickshaw and violently smashing it against a wall. She then immediately grabs another puppy and repeats the same act before calmly returning to her house.

According to Sharma’s post, the alleged attack was linked to a personal dispute between the woman and a family living across the street. He also claimed that when an animal rescue team arrived at the location along with police personnel, the woman locked herself inside her house for nearly an hour.

Sharma further alleged that when the woman eventually stepped outside, she used her child as a shield, apparently hoping to avoid confrontation or strict action.

The activist also claimed that two more puppies were found hanging from a nearby tree, although this allegation has not been independently verified.

Following the incident, police registered an FIR against the accused woman after a complaint by Ajay, a member of People for Animals. According to the complaint, the woman, identified as Meenakshi Mishra, allegedly threw three to four puppies against a wall, resulting in their deaths.

Ajay also alleged that CCTV footage indicates repeated acts of cruelty against animals in the area and claimed that the woman would kill dogs, place them in plastic covers and hang them from a tree. He further said that the police response to the complaint has been slow and that the complainants have not yet received a copy of the FIR.

The shocking visuals have triggered widespread outrage among animal rights activists and social media users, with many demanding strict action under laws protecting animals from cruelty.

articles.title: Dog Walk Turns Violent in Bengaluru Apartment: Senior Citizens, Pet Owner Clash;
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dispute over walking a pet dog inside an apartment complex escalated into a physical altercation involving senior citizens in Bengaluru. The incident took place at Brigade Utopia Apartment in the Varthur area when resident Tarun Arora had taken his dog out for a walk.

body.html:
A dispute over walking a pet dog inside an apartment complex escalated into a physical altercation involving senior citizens in Bengaluru.

The incident took place at Brigade Utopia Apartment in the Varthur area when resident Tarun Arora had taken his dog out for a walk.

According to a police complaint, the apartment complex has a designated area meant for senior citizens to walk and exercise. Arora allegedly brought his dog near the same space, where it reportedly urinated. Senior citizens present there questioned him about bringing the dog close to the walking zone, which led to a heated argument.

The verbal dispute soon escalated into a scuffle, with seven to eight senior citizens allegedly assaulting Arora, kicking and hitting him with their hands. A woman present at the spot intervened and separated the individuals, preventing the situation from escalating further.

Arora later filed a complaint at Varthur Police Station alleging that he was attacked by the group.

However, the matter took another turn when a woman from the group filed a counter-complaint. She alleged that Arora attacked them when they questioned him about the dog urinating in the area and threatened them, reportedly saying that their children live abroad and that he would not spare them. She also claimed they now fear for their safety and have sought police protection.

CCTV footage from the apartment complex reportedly shows a group of senior citizens exercising while Arora walks his dog nearby. The video captures the confrontation, during which one elderly man throws Arora’s phone from his hand, followed by the physical altercation.

Police are currently examining complaints from both sides and investigating the incident.

articles.title: Outrage in Chitrakoot: Headmistress Seen Getting Massage From Students in Viral School Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video from the Karvi area of Chitrakoot district in Uttar Pradesh has gone viral on social media, triggering outrage over alleged misconduct by a government school headmistress. The incident reportedly took place at a government primary school in Naya Bazaar, Karvi.

body.html:
A video from the Karvi area of Chitrakoot district in Uttar Pradesh has gone viral on social media, triggering outrage over alleged misconduct by a government school headmistress.

The incident reportedly took place at a government primary school in Naya Bazaar, Karvi. In the viral footage, a mat can be seen spread on the classroom floor while several young female students appear to be massaging the headmistress, who is lying down comfortably.

According to claims circulating with the video, the woman seen in the footage is Madhu Kumari, the headmistress of the school. The video allegedly shows students massaging her with their hands and even with their feet.

In another part of the clip, a student is reportedly seen using a rolling pin to massage the headmistress while she appears to be using a mobile phone. The incident is said to have occurred during school hours.

The video has sparked strong reactions online and raised concerns among locals about the functioning of the education system. Residents said schools are meant to educate children and shape their future, and such incidents damage the learning environment.

Following the circulation of the video, the Education Department has taken note of the matter and announced that disciplinary action will be initiated against the teacher.

The incident has also drawn sharp criticism on social media, with many users demanding strict action. One user wrote that making schoolgirls massage a teacher is “extremely shameful” and that there should be no compromise on the safety and dignity of children.

articles.title: Ghost or Glitch? Mysterious Shadow Caught on CCTV at Closed Shop in Bareilly Village Sparks Panic
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A mysterious shadow-like figure captured on CCTV at a closed shop in a village of Bareilly district, Uttar Pradesh, has triggered widespread discussion among locals. The incident reportedly took place late at night in Mankara village under the jurisdiction of Mirganj Police Station.

body.html:
A mysterious shadow-like figure captured on CCTV at a closed shop in a village of Bareilly district, Uttar Pradesh, has triggered widespread discussion among locals.

The incident reportedly took place late at night in Mankara village under the jurisdiction of Mirganj Police Station. The CCTV camera installed at an online café owned by village resident Avern Gangwar recorded the unusual activity.

According to reports, Gangwar had shut his online café for the night and returned home. However, when the CCTV footage was reviewed later, a shadow-like figure was seen appearing inside the shop area.

In the footage, the shadow seemingly approaches the shop’s mirror and appears to hit its head against the glass before disappearing.

When the shop owner checked the CCTV recording the next morning, he noticed the unusual scene and informed nearby residents. The footage soon spread across the village, leading to intense speculation among locals.

While some villagers believe the figure could be a ghostly presence, others suspect it might be due to a technical glitch in the CCTV system or a shadow formed by some other object.

The mysterious footage has since become a major topic of discussion in the village.

articles.title: Holi Horror in Ambedkar Nagar: Wife Beats Retired Railway Employee to Death With Stick After
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 75-year-old retired railway employee was allegedly beaten to death by his wife following a dispute over money for alcohol in Ambedkar Nagar district of Uttar Pradesh, police said.

body.html:
A 75-year-old retired railway employee was allegedly beaten to death by his wife following a dispute over money for alcohol in Ambedkar Nagar district of Uttar Pradesh, police said.

The incident took place on Wednesday evening in Mohsinpur Mansoorpur village under the jurisdiction of Akbarpur Police Station. The victim, Hausila Prasad (75), lived with his wife Sangeeta and had retired from the railways.

According to police, both husband and wife had consumed alcohol during Holi celebrations. Around 6 pm, Sangeeta allegedly asked her husband for money to buy more alcohol. When he refused, an argument broke out between the two.

The dispute escalated when the woman allegedly threw her husband to the ground and began beating him repeatedly with a stick. Despite his cries for help, she continued the assault, causing severe injuries.

Hausila Prasad’s condition worsened due to the beating, and he died shortly afterwards.

Some people present at the scene reportedly recorded the incident on their phones. After receiving information from neighbours, police reached the spot, took the body into custody and sent it for postmortem examination.

Police have arrested the accused woman and started questioning her.

Srinivas Pandey, the station in-charge of Akbarpur police station, confirmed the incident and said the woman has been taken into custody and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Holi Night Horror in Gorakhpur: MBBS Student Killed by Speeding Fortuner, Body Hung
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 22-year-old MBBS student died after a speeding and allegedly uncontrolled Toyota Fortuner rammed into his scooter in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, on Wednesday night.

body.html:
A 22-year-old MBBS student died after a speeding and allegedly uncontrolled Toyota Fortuner rammed into his scooter in Gorakhpur, Uttar Pradesh, on Wednesday night.

The victim, Akash Pandey, a third-year MBBS student at BRD Medical College and a resident of Sant Kabir Nagar, had gone to a friend’s house to celebrate Holi. After having dinner there, he was returning to his hostel around 10 pm when the accident occurred on the Mohiddipur–Kauabag overbridge in the Shahpur Police Station area.

According to eyewitnesses, the Fortuner, driven by property dealer Golden Sahni, was moving at high speed and had already hit three to four vehicles before crashing head-on into Akash’s scooter. The impact was so severe that Akash was thrown nearly 15 metres into the air and got stuck face-down on the railing of the overbridge.

Locals gathered at the spot after the crash, but instead of helping, many were seen recording videos. The student remained hanging from the railing for nearly 30 minutes until police arrived after receiving information from passersby.

Police brought him down and rushed him to the district hospital, where doctors declared him dead.

Soon after the incident, Akash’s friend Anoop, at whose house he had dinner, reached the hospital and broke down on seeing the body. Witnesses said he pleaded with doctors, saying, “Doctor sir, please bring my friend back to life.”

After the accident, the Fortuner driver fled the scene. Police quickly launched a search operation and circulated alerts to nearby police stations. Within about one hour, officers traced the vehicle and arrested the driver.

The incident sparked anger among fellow medical students, who gathered at the hospital demanding strict action. Police officials assured them that appropriate legal action would be taken against the accused.

articles.title: Second CCTV Clip From Gonda Family Dispute Goes Viral; Loco Pilot, Mother Allege Assault
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Another CCTV video linked to the viral family dispute in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh, has surfaced online, showing an alleged assault inside the house. The footage is being widely circulated on social media and has sparked strong reactions.

body.html:
Another CCTV video linked to the viral family dispute in Gonda, Uttar Pradesh, has surfaced online, showing an alleged assault inside the house. The footage is being widely circulated on social media and has sparked strong reactions.

According to a complaint filed by Sarita, a resident of Rewa village under the Nawabganj police station area in Gonda district, her son Brajesh Maurya works as a loco pilot with the Indian Railways. Sarita told police that Brajesh had a love marriage with Anita Maurya about a year ago after the two reportedly met through Facebook.

Sarita alleged that disputes began in the family soon after the marriage. She claimed that Anita frequently argued with family members and conflicts had been taking place inside the house.

According to the complaint, a serious argument broke out on February 28 during which Anita allegedly verbally abused and physically assaulted Brajesh. Sarita claimed that when she tried to intervene, she too was abused and beaten. She further alleged that Anita later called her brother to the house, who then joined the clash and allegedly assaulted both Brajesh and Sarita using sticks.

Sarita also alleged that several items inside the house were damaged during the incident, including the door, lights and multiple kitchen items. She has requested the police to take action in the matter.

In another CCTV clip now circulating online, Anita is allegedly seen slapping the 50-year-old Sarita three times within about 30 seconds during an argument. The footage reportedly shows Anita holding Sarita’s hand while she was seated on a sofa and hitting her. At the time of the incident, Brajesh was reportedly on duty in Kanpur.

Sarita has submitted the CCTV footage along with her written complaint at Nawabganj police station. Station House Officer Abhay Singh confirmed that the complaint has been received and said the incident appears to be a domestic dispute within the family. Police said an investigation is underway and action will be taken based on the findings of the inquiry. So far, no arrests have been confirmed in connection with the case.

Reports also indicate that Anita has been missing from the house since the incident.

Meanwhile, the viral videos have triggered strong reactions on social media. Many users expressed anger and concern while discussing domestic conflicts and legal protections. Some posts criticised what they described as gender bias in laws, while others questioned how such family disputes should be handled. The online debate has included several emotional and heated responses.

articles.title: Caught on CCTV: Speeding Bike Hurls Elderly Man Into Air in Sri Ganganagar, Rider Flees Scene
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An elderly man was seriously injured after being hit by a speeding motorcycle in Sri Ganganagar district of Rajasthan, with the shocking incident captured on CCTV cameras. The accident took place around 6:15 pm on Monday (2 Feb 2026) near Pirkhana, Ward No. 23 in Padampur.

body.html:
An elderly man was seriously injured after being hit by a speeding motorcycle in Sri Ganganagar district of Rajasthan, with the shocking incident captured on CCTV cameras.

The accident took place around 6:15 pm on Monday (2 Feb 2026) near Pirkhana, Ward No. 23 in Padampur. According to eyewitnesses, the biker was travelling at high speed when he crashed into the senior citizen.

The impact was so severe that the victim, identified as Satpal Soni, a resident of Ward No. 6, was thrown into the air and landed headfirst on the road. He was reportedly on his way to the market with a woman from his neighbourhood when the crash occurred.

Locals rushed to the spot after hearing the loud impact and shifted the injured man to a nearby private hospital. He sustained serious injuries to his head and leg, and his condition is reported to be critical.

The biker fled the scene immediately after the accident.

CCTV footage of the incident has since surfaced on social media and gone viral, triggering outrage among local residents over reckless driving in the area.

Following a complaint filed by the victim’s family at the Padampur Police Station, police have registered a case and launched an investigation. Officials said the CCTV footage is being examined to identify and trace the biker responsible for the crash.

Residents have also demanded stricter traffic control measures and installation of speed breakers, stating that frequent overspeeding in the area poses a serious threat to pedestrians, especially the elderly and children.
